property_summary: Invariant: In the reference, SetMinSum can always be called before Initialized() (i.e., when intitalized is false) and thus succeeds (does not revert) for any caller and uint value until Initialized() is set; the mutant inverts the check causing SetMinSum to revert whenever intitalized is false, so there exist inputs where the call that should succeed now fails.
change_summary: Invert the initialization check so SetMinSum can only be called after Initialized() has been run (revert unless intitalized is true).
